title: skills, automation: teach the notify audience selectors, org:members included
body:
domain:server#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWRcTEB3toGxnWvuvX

Skills-docs follow-up of #32445 PR 1 (PR #32782, `Metadata-protocol: added`). That PR adds the `org:members` audience: a `notify` node's `recipients: 'org:members'` reaches every member of the notification's organization. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`'s `notify` section (the `### notify — the most-used node type` block) teaches a recipient as an id, a list or an envelope only; it names no audience selector, so an agent authoring an announcement flow will list users or roles by hand.

## Do

- In that `notify` section, teach the selectors a recipient string may be: `team:ID`, `owner_of:OBJECT:ID` and `org:members` (every member of the run's organization, else the organization of the record the notification is about; any other `org:` value reaches nobody with a warning). One line each, net budget about 6 lines.
- Add or extend one eval prompt that asks for an organization-wide announcement flow and expects `recipients: 'org:members'`.
- Follow `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`'s paragraph as PR #32782 lands it; keep the documentation's word rules (no role word in prose, per `check:role-word`).

Blocked-by: #32782 merged (the selector must be on `main` before the skill teaches it).

Filing gate: ② the PR's `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line (review-checklist: the owed card is filed before ACCEPT). class: b · type: Docs · Suggested-grade: p2 · lane: `domain:skills` (triage to confirm).
